title: How to Save Claude Code Tokens? | Quick Start Keeper GitHub Repo
description:
Stop wasting tokens every time you start a new Claude Code chat! This free GitHub repo called "Quick Start Keeper" creates a living, transportable project knowledge layer for Claude Code. It generates a quickstart.md file so the AI instantly understands your codebase layout, build version, and deploy info without re-reading every file. Perfect for complex projects and teams looking to stay efficient.

Type 'link' in the comments for the repo URL!
